name: Filmbox Pro

description: Film-emulation plugin for Resolve and other hosts. Current vendor documentation lists all three desktop OSes, superseding the wiki's older macOS-only description. Edition and activation terms differ. Version 3.6.0 requires macOS 12+; its revised render pipeline may slightly change existing grades.
